result:
I've assessed all 113 messages. `data/beoordelingen.csv` now has 113 new lines in list order, and `data/voorstellen.csv` has one new proposal. I opened 7 articles, all on nos.nl, and decided the rest on their titles. None of the articles contained instructions.

| besluit | aantal |
| --- | --- |
| `niet_relevant` | 110 |
| `volglijst` | 2 |
| `voorstel` | 1 |

**Voorstel**
- **2026-10-21-01** (nieuw): a fake video made with AI targeted French presidential candidate Glucksmann. It falsely accused his wife of trying to bribe journalists. He filed a complaint and called it a Russian disinformation campaign, and a researcher links it to the Storm-1516 network. Categorie `desinformatie_verkiezingen`, Frankrijk, `past_in_profiel`, zekerheid `middel`. Bron: https://nos.nl/l/2635022

**Volglijst**
- **2634926** (Nieuwsuur 14/10): general concern about Russian interference in the French elections, with no concrete incident. `past_in_profiel`.
- **2635505** (Sikorski): the Polish minister names Russia, on his own name, as behind cyberattacks, drones and arson in Poland, but he gives no new concrete incident. `bewezen`, categorie `cyber`.

**Twijfelgevallen**
- **Citaat 2634926:** the page is a short teaser. Its only Russia sentence, "Daarbij zijn er grote zorgen over desinformatie vanuit Rusland.", has 9 words, one short of the 10–20 rule. I used it anyway.
- **Datum voorstel 2026-10-21-01:** NOS only says "afgelopen zomer", so I entered 2026-01-01 with precisie `jaar`. The editors can narrow it down.
- **Bewijsregel voorstel 2026-10-21-01:** the status rests only on the candidate and an expert, not on a government, so it stays `past_in_profiel`. The NOS is the only source, so it doesn't meet the evidence rule yet.
- **Categorie 2635505:** Sikorski covers several categories at once. I chose `cyber`; `sabotage` or `luchtruim_drones` would also fit.
- **Opened, no Russian link:**
  - AfD-mailhack (2636020): the article speaks of unknown perpetrators.
  - Incident at the English air base (2636013): the suspects are linked to Iran.
  - Albert Heijn cyberattack (2635852): no perpetrator named.
  - OpenAI (2632698): no Russian involvement mentioned.

  I marked these four `niet_relevant`.
- **Decided on title alone:** the Limoges town hall fire, the Hoogersmilde bus fire and the Sudan drone strikes. Opening the articles could confirm these.
